summary: Faz-5 Hardening Iteration-5 testing complete. All 15 backend tests passed. SHA-256 artifact integrity verified for exchange_evidence, fallback_replay_evidence, and replay_risk_summary artifacts. artifact_manifest.json schema validated with all required fields. Verify endpoint returns expected vs actual hash with verified flag and detects tampered artifacts. Verify action writes audit log. Admin /api/audit/admin/proofs list endpoint works with correct schema. Download endpoint returns artifact JSON. Replay run creates exactly one risk_policy_audit_events record (no duplicates on repeated risk-summary calls). Regression tests pass for lifecycle-proof and risk-summary endpoints with artifact signing. Frontend Admin Proofs Panel at /admin/proofs loads correctly with 38 proof rows, Verify and Download buttons functional.
critical_code_review_comments: SHA-256 artifact integrity verified: exchange_evidence, fallback_replay_evidence, replay_risk_summary all have valid checksums matching manifest
artifact_manifest.json entries include all required fields: artifact_id, filename, artifact_type, sha256, size, created_at
GET /api/audit/artifacts/{artifact_id}/verify returns sha256_expected, sha256_actual, verified flag correctly
Tamper detection working: modifying artifact file causes verify to return verified=false with hash mismatch
Verify action writes audit log entry with action='artifact_verify', entity_type='artifact', severity based on verified result
GET /api/audit/admin/proofs returns list with ArtifactManifestItemResponse schema (artifact_id, filename, artifact_type, sha256, size, created_at, proof_id, evidence_type, status)
GET /api/audit/artifacts/{artifact_id}/download returns artifact JSON file with content-disposition header
Replay run completion creates exactly one risk_policy_audit_events record - _persist_risk_policy_audit_event checks for existing record before insert
POST /api/exchange/lifecycle-proof functional with artifact signing - returns exchange_artifact_id, fallback_artifact_id (when blocked), exchange_evidence_file
GET /api/backtest/replay/{run_id}/risk-summary functional with artifact signing - returns artifact_id, export_file from write_signed_artifact

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Admin Proofs Panel loads with 38 rows, Verify/Download buttons work)

Frontend Admin Proofs Panel at /admin/proofs displays proof rows with all artifact types and Verify/Download buttons work correctly.
